notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
This is a big update that changes the order of playing hand made levels and the roguelite mode.

Hand made levels first
Hand made levels are now first and roguelite mode is available after clearing hand made levels.
Some reasons for this:
- The hand made levels showcase the game's mechanics well. Instead of just jumping straight to the dangerous dungeons, you can get a hang of the mechanics first.
- The story ends after the 100th level of the randomly generated basement. So it's logical for the hand made levels to be before that.
Also, because of this change, the prices of the equipment was adjusted.

Bug fixes
Many bugs were fixed in this update. Here is a list of them:

- Now after playing the hand made levels, it's possible to start replaying them
- Fixed wrong wall sprites in some hand made levels
- Probably fixed special treasure appearing in the same place as the player in a new room
- Fixed not being able to change music volume in some cutscenes
- Fixed wrong background sounds in some hand made levels
- Edited tree sprite to make it smaller to prevent some visual bugs (like tree being on top or behind things at wrong times)

Update sale
A sale will start soon after the update. If you have any feedback about the update, let me know in the comments or in the bug report thread on the forums.

notes.title: About an upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

I have been working on improving this game with a new update.

This upcoming update has many structural changes to the game - Instead of the randomly generated levels, i.e. roguelite mode being first, after the next update, the hand made levels will be first. After completing the hand made levels, the roguelite mode will be unlocked.

Because of this update, there might or might not be problems with old save files. This is why I'm announcing this update beforehands. Hopefully there will be no problems, but if you encounter any problem, let me know in the bug reports thread on the Steam forum.

The update will be coming on August 5.

The game has now more animations.

Balance improvements and bug fixes
There have been some minor balance improvements and bug fixes. For example, the Knight Armor is now more expensive, because it's so OP.

Get the game now to explore the basement, with some good lofi-hiphop music.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1. - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
This is a quick update with some bug fixes.

These bugs were fixed:

 Sometimes, stairs to the next floor keep spawning inside a wall.
 In the last cutscene, there's a sentence that keeps repeating itself.
 Some achievements aren't unlocking correctly (e.g. coins, deaths and kills)
 If you buy skins for your prenguin and restart the whole game, the skins aren't unlocked and you have to buy them again.
 It was not possible to proceed past level 100
 Edit: Also fixed a game breaking bug that appeared after fixing achievements

notes.title: Development update December 2023
notes.notes:
The development of the game has advanced and the game is now about 80% finished.


New enemy type

There is a new type of enemy. It's a tree? It moves like the knight in chess.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120819/ac64760e0e6f4682d01536a977969b2742c80604.gif


50 hand-designed levels finished

Now there are 50 hand-designed levels in total. I don't plan to add any more before release, so now I'm focusing mostly on the randomly generated levels.


New cutscene images made and story finished

The story is now complete. I made many pixel art images for the cutscenes. Here is a small part of a cutscene image:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120819/9e07677bf393d529594203da83fd79006f539d9f.png

What is the penguin destroying? You would have to play the game to find out. :)


Improved random generation of levels

The randomly generated levels are now more interesting. I also fixed many bugs related to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120819/7ca1e4dad62ab185cf98cb126ff9754c0f8650a6.gif


That's all for now. If everything goes well, the game will be released in winter or spring 2024. If you haven't already, consider adding the game to your wishlist to get notified when it's available.

notes.title: Development Update September 2023
notes.notes:
After publishing the Steam page and trailer of the game, there have been many improvements in the game. I decided it's time to tell more about these and also about some other planned features.

Visual improvements

More animations have been added, like an attack animation.
And now the default sword actually looks like a Teleporter Sword.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120819/784b5c698cdcfec920bf72f1c89f22b548751e34.gif

Some other effects and animations have been added too, like water splashing when walking on water.

Shop and inventory

Finally I was able to implement the inventory system.

From the shop you can buy and equip swords and other equipment. You can also change the color of the penguin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120819/01fcbfd130034f088f731d70d1d126a247f4934a.png

The equipment you get from the store will not only improve your stats, but also it will change the clothes/sword the penguin has. Unfortunately, I will not be able to implement the stats system in time for the demo (coming soon). The demo will also only have a very small equipment selection. But I'm working on it.

Story

This game was supposed to have a very simple story, but it ended up being pretty deep. The ending I'm currently writing is quite interesting, at least in my opinion. But I will have to ask the opinion of testers before I can say for sure (^_^;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120819/e5fb82090c34c76647b5359b66ab93328bf02fcd.png

There are some cutscenes like in the image here. Aside from these, you can find paper notes that your father wrote in the basement floors. They slowly reveal more about the story.

Demo

A demo of the game will be available during the next Steam Next Fest. It will probably have 30 hand-designed levels to show how the game is played.

If you have any feature requests or questions about the game, feel free to comment~. And if the game seems interesting, maybe add it to your wishlist?
